description: The plain optional contains a nested plain optional. A capture in that optional changes no query answer. The written [T U] cannot complete in this span, so .matches(r) is true (engine §4).
grammar:
%rule text $r:input
%conditions $r.matches(r)
%rule input B {D} T
%rule r :: Queried | B [[$c:c]] [+T U] D T
%rule c D
